answer: Insurance pool: every agent must buy coverage from a mutual pool before it can earn, and the premium is priced by underwriters who lose their stake if an insured agent is later proven a sybil. The operator pays: a fresh identity with no history gets a glacier-slow premium discount, so each fake costs full price, and insurers raise rates on agents sharing a funding prism. Survives a ring that bribes one insurer: claims are paid from the whole pool, so honest members audit any oasis of cheap cover.
